name: Exterior Porch Floor RP Condition Assessment
intent: RP assessment — condition rating, coating type ID, moisture tests. All FIXED time.
doctrine: RP assessment. All FIXED, no modifiers. Condition assessment includes tape-pull adhesion, scratch test, photo documentation. Coating ID determines if bonding primer needed (unknown = bonding primer). Concrete moisture test on peeling only (upward moisture migration). Wood MC <15% mandatory.
